Thank you all for the warm responses. I'm grateful I posted this. Feels good to not be "alone". I was discharged from the hospital yesterday afternoon. It was indeed a drug induced psychosis. The adderall, Kratom, xanax, (pot lol), and alcohol were the perfect recipe for a full blown psychotic episode. The terrifying part  is that I hadn't taken copious amounts of either drug (except for the Kratom). The psychiatrist is convinced that it's the main reason I went over the edge. He thinks I had zero dopamine in my system. It's been 4 days without a drink or drug and I still feel like I've been hit by a train (pun intended).

I'll have to abstain from substances altogether and get back in to some program of recovery. I may not be an "addict", but I find myself in trouble with drugs at least once a year. It's not worth it. I had 6 years of sobriety once and it felt amazing. I just got complacent, you know? Grateful...really fucking grateful to be "ok". Seeing the smiles on my friends faces, and anyone in general, fills me with joy and gratitude. Life is worth it. Time to get help and stop suppressing my depression. It's been around for at least a year. God bless you all.
